title: フェブラリーSの後に・はじめて

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Phew! I ran sooo fast!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: That was a blast! So this is what "gee one" races are like, huh?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Hey, Trainer! Did you see who was in the stands? My shopkeeper friends came to watch!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: I was waving at them. Do you think they saw?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Come to think of it, before she came back, I did see a group in the stands waving their hands vigorously.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: You think they'll come to my next race, too? Which one am I doing next?
choice_data_list: You don't have one in mind?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Huh? As long as I can run, I'll do any of them!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: That's just like her to say. I'd rather she have a specific race she wants to shoot for, but…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In any case, if she wants to enter the Arima Kinen, then there's only so many races to choose from.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: If she wants to run in the Arima Kinen, she needs to get used to races that are longer than a mile. To that effect, the race I have in mind is only a hundred meters longer than this one, but…

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Okay!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: I'll tell my shopkeeper friends I'm entering the Elm Stakes then!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: What?! That far?! I guess there's no way they could come, then.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Heehee. But if I do good in it, then I can go somewhere they can come watch me!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Okey-dokey! Time to prepare for my concert!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Haru Urara goes back to the waiting room, and I head backstage.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Wow! There's so many people! Way more than usual!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I wi―huh?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Hmph.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Haru Urara's gaze lands on an Umamusume with an unhappy face. She ran in today's race, too.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Hey, are you okay?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: U-Urara… Yeah, I'm fine, I guess…

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: But you look so sad! The concert's about to start. You're not happy?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Look, so many people came out to watch us! Where's that smile you always have?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: How can I smile right now?!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: I finally got into a G1 race… I finally had a chance! But I blew it!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: I wanted to win! But I didn't even make it to the center stage! I'm a loser!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: How can I smile at a time like this? I'm so, so angry! I can't smile!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Angry?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: …Sorry, forget it. I'm fine. I'll put on a happy face for the show.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Sigh… Next time, I will be center stage!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: …She left.
choice_data_list: Is she a friend of yours?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Yeah. She's smiling all the time. She's super nice to everybody, too…

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: I've never seen her like this…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Haru Urara seems shocked. Seeing a new side of her friend like this must've really impacted her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However…

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Oh, right! Okay, I gotta give it my all!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Haru Urara regains her composure and heads toward the stage.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: During the second half of the show, I join the audience and see that Special Week has come to watch.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ah! Urara's trainer! Hello!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Urara looks like she's having so much fun dancing! Just watching her gets me excited, too!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: That's why I love coming to see her concerts!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Just like Special Week says, Haru Urara's charm is in how much energy she exudes.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: That's why everyone loves her. No matter how many times she fails, she's always smiling.

text_block_list.name: Energetic Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text: Urara always tries so hard.

text_block_list.name: Energetic Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text: I want to see her smiling on the Arima Kinen stage too. I hope she qualifies…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I overhear a familiar voice. Looking over, I see the shopkeepers from the shopping district talking while watching the performance.

text_block_list.name: Kind Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text: But can she even enter the Arima Kinen at this rate? Her results aren't great…

text_block_list.name: Happy Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text: I wonder if there's anything we can do to help…

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Oh, the show's almost over, huh?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: When you go back, please tell Urara I said the show was fantastic!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I head back to the waiting room with the shopkeepers' conversation still fresh in my mind.
